status_reason: The indicator ended after FY2023: the FY2023 MMR removed it while the Scorecard inspection program is overhauled, and no FY2024-FY2026 values exist. FY2019 has no rating (MMR prints NA).
name: Streets rated acceptably clean
definition: Share of city streets rated acceptably clean by the Mayor's Office of Operations Scorecard inspection program, fiscal year average, as reported in the Mayor's Management Report.

source.name: Mayor's Management Report, Department of Sanitation indicator 'Streets rated acceptably clean (%)' (FY2013, FY2018 and FY2022 editions), plus MMR open data for FY2023

method: Fiscal-year values printed in the Mayor's Management Report: each edition prints five fiscal years, so the FY2013 edition supplies FY2009-FY2013, the FY2018 edition FY2014-FY2018 and the FY2022 edition FY2018-FY2022 (where editions overlap the later one is used). FY2023 was never printed in an MMR; it is the June year-to-date value in the MMR open data, as assembled in the mmr-explorer project, which the script also uses to check FY2018 and FY2020-FY2022. Sources by year: FY2009: FY2013 MMR, Department of Sanitation chapter, PDF page 2; FY2010: FY2013 MMR, Department of Sanitation chapter, PDF page 2; FY2011: FY2013 MMR, Department of Sanitation chapter, PDF page 2; FY2012: FY2013 MMR, Department of Sanitation chapter, PDF page 2; FY2013: FY2013 MMR, Department of Sanitation chapter, PDF page 2; FY2014: FY2018 MMR, Department of Sanitation chapter, PDF page 2; FY2015: FY2018 MMR, Department of Sanitation chapter, PDF page 2; FY2016: FY2018 MMR, Department of Sanitation chapter, PDF page 2; FY2017: FY2018 MMR, Department of Sanitation chapter, PDF page 2; FY2018: FY2022 MMR, Department of Sanitation chapter, PDF page 3; FY2020: FY2022 MMR, Department of Sanitation chapter, PDF page 3; FY2021: FY2022 MMR, Department of Sanitation chapter, PDF page 3; FY2022: FY2022 MMR, Department of Sanitation chapter, PDF page 3; FY2023: MMR open data (rbed-zzin, June year-to-date value) via mmr-explorer.
caveats: No ratings were reported for FY2019 (the MMR prints NA).

The FY2023 MMR (https://www.nyc.gov/assets/operations/downloads/pdf/mmr2023/2023_mmr.pdf, PDF page 59) removed the indicator, saying the Scorecard street cleanliness inspection program is being overhauled because its scoring system was developed in the 1970s. The same note corrects values first misreported in the FY2022 MMR (FY2021 from 89.6 to 93.7, FY2022 from 90.8 to 89.6); the corrected values are used here.
The Scorecard open dataset (rqhp-hivt) has no ratings after 2023 / 09.
